import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter1 = ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=data['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Physical Activity Level Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(data['Physical Activity Level'], bins=15, color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90, explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sleep_disorder = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, 
               color=colors[1:len(disorder_counts)+1], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Age vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
scatter2 = ax5.scatter(data['Age'], data['Heart Rate'], 
                       c=data['BMI Category'].astype('category').cat.codes, 
                       cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Age vs Heart Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Daily Steps Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.boxplot(data['Daily Steps'], vert=True, patch_artist=True,
            boxprops=dict(facecolor=colors[2], alpha=0.7),
            medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2))
ax6.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Stress Level by Occupation
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
occupation_stress = data.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.values, 
                color=colors[3], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_stress)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(occupation_stress.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Stress Level by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 8. Correlation Heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numeric Variables', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
